title: Float Valve

introduction.definition: A float valve automatically keeps a tank at a set level. A float on a lever arm rises with the liquid; the lever pushes a plunger onto the seat and throttles the inlet until it closes at the full level. When liquid is drawn off, the float drops and the valve reopens.
key_points: Fit an overflow in case it fails
introduction.summary: A float valve keeps a tank at a set level automatically. A float on a lever arm rises with the liquid; the lever pushes a plunger onto the seat and gradually closes the inlet as the tank fills. When the level falls, the float drops and the valve opens again.

foundation: Support the valve and adjoining pipe so the body does not carry pipe weight or thermal loads; heavy valves need their own supports.
alignment: Align flanges face-to-face and bore-to-bore before bolting; never pull pipes into place with the bolts.
Respect the flow-direction arrow on the body.
piping: Fit an isolating valve upstream and an overflow/warning pipe on the tank.
Keep the float free of walls and baffles.
commissioning: Check the valve strokes fully and smoothly.
Pressure-test the line (shell test) with the valve partly open; do not use the valve to blind a test above its seat rating.
Record the as-installed position and set points.

routine.task: Check level is maintained and no overflow.

overhaul.task: Check float for leaks and lever pivot for wear.

lubrication: Pivot pins: no lubrication for potable water service; keep clean.

causes: Worn washer, punctured float, stuck lever
High supply pressure, valve too large

video_tutorials.title: Float Valve — Introduction

script.narration: This module introduces the Float Valve.
A float valve automatically keeps a tank at a set level.
A float on a lever arm rises with the liquid; the lever pushes a plunger onto the seat and throttles the inlet until it closes at the full level.
When liquid is drawn off, the float drops and the valve reopens.
Typical applications include water storage and break tanks; cooling-tower basins; livestock troughs and cisterns; make-up to process tanks.
The cutaway reveals the internal construction: Valve Body, Seat & Outlet Nozzle.
The exploded view separates every component so each one can be tapped for its function, material and failure modes.
Next, watch the operation tutorial to see how it works.

video_tutorials.title: Float Valve — Operation

script.narration: How the Float Valve works.
Water enters through the inlet pipe and seat.
As the level rises the float lifts.
The lever pushes the plunger and washer towards the seat, reducing flow.
At full level the washer seals the seat and flow stops.
When water is used the level falls, the float drops and the valve opens again.
The flow overlay traces the liquid from suction to discharge.

video_tutorials.title: Float Valve — Maintenance

script.narration: Maintenance essentials for the Float Valve.
Check level is maintained and no overflow.
Replace the washer when passing.
Check float for leaks and lever pivot for wear.
Watch for overflow: water at overflow. Common cause: worn washer, punctured float, stuck lever.
Watch for water hammer / noise: banging on closing. Common cause: high supply pressure, valve too large.
Record every inspection so trends — vibration, temperature, leakage and performance — can be compared over time.
